Envato, “Trend Deep Dive: Neo-brutalism”

A stock-marketplace trend brief that carries the name into print templates and social graphics.

Source
Envato Author Hub
Creator
Joanna Birleson, Envato
Made
2023
Style
Neo-brutalism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Loud, playful
Evidence
Article text read on 2026-09-25. Published 9 November 2023 per the page metadata.
Reviewed
25 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Key traits listed: “Bold modern typography”, “Bold and vibrant colors often with high contrast”, “Lack of gradients”, and “Hard shadows, dark contrasts and outlines”. It advises that shadows “should be black and should have 100% opacity”.

It applies the name beyond screens: templates “can be adapted to various mediums such as printed posters, flyers and designer portfolios”, and an Envato graphics reviewer encourages authors “to explore Neo-brutalism for print templates”.

Like Malewicz, it cites Figma and Gumroad as site examples.

Why it belongs

Evidence that by late 2023 the name was a commercial template category that spans print and social media, not only web UI.
